exact_actual_prerequisite.production_metadata_comparison: Validate original producer/source chain and original operation exposure separately; new operation lifecycle flags are never compared with a completed predecessor output before they occur.

existing_code_and_profiles: All unchanged. New G31 header-loop adaptation changes only finite MEMBER_KIND_PROFILE gate, adds bounded OPC checks and preserves all remaining header predicates; no monkeypatch/global fallback.

lexical_subsets.media_type: ASCII RFC token/token subset, no parameters or whitespace; exact expected types on old known names. Declared type is not payload verification.
lexical_subsets.ordinary_segment_additional: No trailing dot; old canonical-member restrictions still apply. Prefix name grammar excludes Media Types stream only.
lexical_subsets.relationship_internal_target: Package-absolute or source-directory-relative ASCII path; literal dot-segment resolution with no escape above root; no scheme/authority/query/fragment/percent/backslash/empty segment; final canonical existing unique part required.
lexical_subsets.relationship_type: Absolute ASCII HTTP(S) URI only: nonempty syntactically valid hostname, no userinfo/port, path/query/fragment use URI ASCII characters with valid percent triplets; preserve exact string and case. Unsupported forms block; no fetch or normalization.
lexical_subsets.selected_text: Plain inline string or simple shared-string text only. Formula/cache-derived or unsupported rich-text semantics block required mapping; no style inference or digit stripping.

output_boundary.opaque_part_semantics: UNINTERPRETED; no harmlessness, dependency-independence, rendering or full OPC/OOXML conformance claim.
output_boundary.scientific_citations: Only in frozen provenance disclosure fields, preserving original identities and known conflicts.
output_boundary.scientific_status: No scientific schema/protocol admission from layout alone. End states concern metadata readiness of a named claim only.

phases.depends_on: exact G34 prerequisite plus current root implementation/publication gates
phases.does_not_open: shared strings, styles, other worksheet or opaque part payloads
phases.name: layout
phases.opens: original four envelope members, all identified relationship members, and two exact G32 documentary role worksheets

phases.depends_on: two identical qualifying layout receipts plus frozen full documentary coordinate/type/disclosure binding
phases.name: documentary
phases.opens: revalidated metadata, only bound documentary roles, and one known-type/sharedStrings relationship if required

phases.depends_on: two identical qualifying documentary receipts plus frozen complete record-sheet/row/metadata/join binding and authenticated target-redacted overlap manifest if claiming overlap resolution
phases.name: frame
phases.opens: revalidated metadata, all and only bound record worksheets, and validated shared strings if required

pure_policy: Exact generated bytes only, reject known actual identity, no file output/capture/network/production guard. Immutable bytes are passed unchanged through all invoked stages.
scope: One restricted general OPC package plus complete documentary/frame readiness route; no numerical outcome extraction.
stop_rules: Any source/producer/prerequisite/same-buffer replay mismatch blocks before XML.
Unsupported name/type/relationship/workbook/worksheet rule or bound stops this route, not a new per-field milestone.
Unbound/mixed documentary scope, unsupported semantic dependency, missing use rights or incomplete frame/pairing yields named NO_GO with unknowns retained.
No normalization repair, exception-by-observed-name, cap growth, sheet substitution, row trimming or outcome-based selection.
Root may authorize narrow implementation defect fixes with preserved first failures; substantive scope change is never automatic.
